build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run check:readonly && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' markvy: http://markvy.localhost data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Read Markdown documents and wikis like a well-designed book.
bundle.longDescription: Markvy opens Markdown documents and wiki folders on your computer, shows them like a book, and lets you edit them like a Word document. It changes your files only when you press Save, rename or delete, and works offline. Pictures from the internet are shown only if you allow it.
